caption: This gave me reason to keep going!
author: DIA
transcript: This 45 second experiment will change your life entirely, and for that to work, I want you to close your eyes. And I know what you're gonna say, oh let me just watch this with my eyes open, but trust me on this one, if you don't close your eyes, this experiment becomes kinda pointless. So close your eyes now. Imagine it's 10 years later in the future, and your life is exactly the opposite of what you wanted it to be. You have a job that you hate, you hate the people around you, you don't like your physique, and you're not happy at all. You really really hate your life. One night, at around 3am, when you're on your phone, you see a picture of yourself from 10 years ago, and you say to yourself, if I could go back 10 years in time, I'd change my life entirely. If this opportunity was given to me, that I could go back 10 years in time, everything would be different. And you begged God to give you back that chance. Now, open your eyes. You just came back 10 years in time. Out of all the people who asked for this chance, God gave it to you only. So tell me, what are you gonna do with it?
title: You Just Got 10 Years Back
one_liner: A guided visualization forces you to confront regret and reignite motivation to change now.
key_points: Imagine your life in 10 years went completely wrong — bad job, unhappy, unfulfilled
You see a photo of your younger self and beg for a second chance
The twist: opening your eyes means you already have that second chance right now
Uses prospective regret as a psychological trigger to spark immediate action
